name: Hive Thermostat Mini (UK)

radios.note: Hive says its heating devices use Zigbee for local communication. The page doesn't state a Wi-Fi radio on the thermostat, so none is listed.

matter.note: No Matter claim found on Hive's Mini page.

apple_home.note: Hive's Mini page lists Apple HomeKit. Hive's HomeKit guide pairs through a Hive Hub and doesn't name the Mini; hot water, boost and schedules aren't controllable in Apple Home.

google_home.note: Listed on the Mini page. Link your Hive account in Google Home under Home Control; the guide doesn't name the Mini.

alexa.note: The Mini page lists Amazon Alexa; Hive's Alexa support page doesn't name the Mini.

smartthings.note: No Hive page found lists SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Hive integration lists Hive Active Heating, Multi-zone and Radiator Valve but not the Thermostat Mini; it is cloud-polling via your Hive account.

hubRequired.note: Hive's Mini page doesn't say. Its box contents list no hub, and one FAQ on the page says the first thermostat comes with a Hive Hub. UK retailers sell both hub and hubless bundles. Check the bundle you buy.

localControl.note: Hive says the thermostat keeps working and adjusts temperature without internet, but app control returns only when it's back. That isn't local control, so left unconfirmed.

thermostatType.note: Battery thermostat that switches your boiler through a mains receiver.

systems.value: UK gas, LPG, oil and electric boilers; OpenTherm on some combis
systems.note: No heat pumps, solid fuel or storage heaters. Hot water is on/off and boost only. Several Worcester Bosch models are listed as incompatible.

summary: Hive lists Alexa, Google Home and Apple HomeKit for the Thermostat Mini, a battery-powered UK thermostat that switches your boiler through a mains receiver. Alexa and Google Home link through your Hive account, while Apple Home goes through a Hive Hub. It suits most gas, LPG, oil and electric boilers, plus OpenTherm on some combis, but not heat pumps. Whether the Mini needs a hub isn't stated, and Matter isn't claimed.
caveats: Hive doesn't state whether the Mini needs a Hive Hub; check the bundle you buy.
Not for heat pumps, solid fuel boilers or storage heaters, and several Worcester Bosch models are listed as incompatible.
Hot water can only be switched on or off, scheduled or boosted for 1 to 6 hours, not set to a temperature.
OpenTherm works on compatible combi boilers and single-zone systems only.
In Apple Home, hot water, boost and schedules still need the Hive app.
